newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 5.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Two British nurses charged with murdering an Australian colleague at a hospital in Saudi Arabia have retracted their confessions, their Saudi lawyer said.
- Al-Rajhi Banking and Investment Corp and Federal Bank of India signed a business agreement to help tens of thousands of Indian expatriates send money home.
- Saudi Ceramics Co is to raise its capital to 200 million riyals by granting free shares to shareholders on a one for three basis, the chairman said.
